explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/9: infinitely many odd integers are not of the form p + 2^k + 2^l (Crocker [Cr71]; the docstring also records Erdős crediting Schinzel). `Erdos9A` is the odd n with no primes p and k, l ≥ 0 giving n = p + 2^k + 2^l, matching the page, and `Infinite` is the claim. Faithful.
